Три способа дообучить на одних попытках: Three ways to fine-tune on the same attempts
Те же 100 попыток — три дообучения от од: The same 100 attempts, three fine-tunings from the same weights with the same network, 3,000 steps each. “Successes only” takes the successful attempts whole. “All labeled” takes all 100: a value function scores every step, and a label goes into the policy's input saying whether the step is better than usual or not; in the test, the label always says “better”. “All unlabeled” copies all 100 as is. Чем вмешательство в HIL-SERL отличается: How does an intervention in HIL-SERL differ from HG-DAgger in lesson 1.2?
Ничем: человек так же перехватывает упра: In no way: the person takes over just the same
Данные те же, но учится политика по-друг: The data is the same, but the policy learns differently: the human's steps go into the buffers, and reinforcement learning optimizes the reward instead of copying the human; with the same number of attempts and interventions, HG-DAgger averaged 49.7% versus 100%
В HIL-SERL человек вмешивается только в: In HIL-SERL, the person intervenes only at the end of training
Авторы HIL-SERL сравнивали именно так: H: That's exactly how the HIL-SERL authors compared them: HG-DAgger got the same number of episodes and interventions. Its intervention rate didn't fall over time, while RL's went down to zero.
Зачем HIL-SERL хранит шаги человека в дв: Why does HIL-SERL keep the human's steps in two buffers?
Для надёжности: один буфер может потерят: For reliability: one buffer might get lost
Чтобы обучение брало половину каждого па: So that training takes half of each batch from the demonstration buffer: the rare human steps are seen often, while the policy's steps come only from the experience buffer
Чтобы отделить удачные попытки от неудач: To separate successful attempts from failed ones
Симметричная выборка из RLPD: половина п: This is symmetric sampling from RLPD: half of the batch comes from pre-collected data and half from experience. In Lab 2, the same corrections without the second buffer gave noticeably fewer successful starts from the adjacent slot.
Откуда в HIL-SERL берётся награда?: Where does the reward come from in HIL-SERL?
Её задаёт человек вручную на каждом шаге: A person sets it by hand at every step
Классификатор по кадрам камер отвечает «: A classifier looks at the camera frames and answers “done: 1, not done: 0”; it's trained on 200 success examples and 1,000 failure examples, about 5 minutes of recording
Награда — расстояние до цели по датчикам: The reward is the distance to the goal measured by sensors
Награда разреженная: 1 только при заверш: The reward is sparse: 1 only when the task is completed. The authors note that for complex tasks, designing a dense reward by hand isn't feasible, while the classifier gets by with about ten recordings.
RECAP учит VLA только на удачных попытка: Does RECAP train a VLA only on successful attempts?
Да: неудачные попытки выбрасывают: Yes: failed attempts are thrown out
Нет: на всех, а во вход модели пишут «Ad: No: on all of them, with “Advantage: positive” or “negative” written into the model's input according to each step's advantage; at run time, positive is written
Нет: на всех, но с одинаковыми весами: No: on all of them, but with equal weights
Взвешенная регрессия (AWR) выбрасывает и: Weighted regression (AWR) discards or heavily downweights most of the data, and a policy gradient is hard to apply to flow matching. On T-shirt folding, AWR gave a decent success rate, but a noticeably slower policy and lower throughput than RECAP.
Почему в RECAP шаги исправлений оператор: Why does RECAP always label the operator's correction steps as positive?
Потому что оператор всегда действует опт: Because the operator always acts optimally
Потому что это допущение: авторы считают: Because it's an assumption: the authors treat corrections as good actions, even though the operator can't guarantee their quality; corrections are there to fix gross mistakes, not to fine-tune the speed
Потому что функция ценности не умеет их: Because the value function can't score them
Авторы π*0.6 прямо пишут, что вмешательс: The π*0.6 authors say outright that an intervention is a disruptive event and that even an expert can't ensure consistent quality; corrections fix the big misses, while autonomous experience labeled by value refines the speed and the details.
Функция ценности в RECAP предсказывает в: Does the value function in RECAP predict the probability of success?
Нет: число шагов до успешного завершения: No: the number of steps until successful completion with a minus sign, normalized by the task length; a failure gets a large negative penalty
Нет: сумму наград за все 50 Гц действия: No: the sum of rewards over all the 50 Hz actions
Поэтому преимущество шага показывает, пр: So a step's advantage shows whether it brought success closer and by how much: fast steps get positive and slow ones negative, even within successful attempts. That's how throughput grows.
Дообучать VLA с подкреплением лучше, чем: Is fine-tuning a VLA with reinforcement learning better than training an RL policy from scratch with the same interventions?
Нет: VLA только мешает: No: the VLA only gets in the way
Да, по ConRFT: от предобученной VLA 96,3: Yes, according to ConRFT: starting from a pre-trained VLA gives 96.3% on average in 45–90 minutes, while HIL-SERL from scratch with the same time and interventions gets 31.9%
Одинаково: результат определяется числом: They're the same: the result is set by the number of interventions
Предобученная модель начинает с осмыслен: A pre-trained model starts with sensible movements, and its exploration does less damage to the scene. HIL-SERL from scratch, according to the ConRFT authors, does reach good policies, but in over two hours and with more interventions.
